intro: Tallonkai's Jewel is a luminous emerald stolen from an enchanted druidic talisman on Teldrassil. Prized by the furbolg mystic Ferocitas the Dream Eater, it serves as the crucial centerpiece required to mend the Emerald Dreamcatcher.

p: Tallonkai Swiftroot crafted the Emerald Dreamcatcher as a potent focus tuned to nature and the sleeping realm. When his talisman was damaged, the central radiant emerald was pried loose and carried off into the wilds of eastern Teldrassil. The jewel fell into the paws of Ferocitas the Dream Eater, a corrupted Gnarlpine leader who fashioned the gleaming stone into a personal necklace. While the green stone cast an eerie glow in the forest gloom, its true harmonious resonance was entirely useless to the furbolg, serving merely as a trophy until retrieved.
